requirements.text: Patients must be able to book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online
Patients must be able to request repeat prescriptions online
Patients must have secure access to their test results online
System must implement secure identity verification for patient login and actions
The system must provide users with clear instructions or prompts during the appointment management process
Patients cannot view their test results until a clinician has reviewed and authorized them
The portal must integrate smoothly with existing practice management software
The portal must meet accessibility guidelines for all patients
The portal must have 99.9% uptime during clinic hours
